blind.description: A stylized low wooden roof dormer featuring a sloped shed roof with overlapping wooden shingles and a thick top ridge beam. The front has two small four-pane square windows, each flanked by open wooden shutters. The side and rear walls consist of vertical wooden plank panels inset into a heavy timber frame. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and textured with hand-painted stylized wood grains in warm browns, tans, and orange-wood accents, with no broken geometry or floating parts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular sloping roof covered in tiered wooden shingles, bordered along the top edge by a thick wooden ridge plank.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 0.45 times the height of the figure (approx. 2.5 feet tall) and roughly 4.5 feet wide.
